canonical_project: NSP Data Center / Network Servers Power colocation facility
notes: NSP's project page describes its owned data processing center and colocation infrastructure; Trend reported the NSP-built first international data center opened in February 2018 with 80 racks, 500 sqm area, 300 kW initial electrical power expandable to 500 kW. RackCorp markets NSP as a Chuy Region/Bishkek-area facility, so this line is assigned to Chuy rather than Bishkek city.
